machine_found_limitations: Found date checks can match only month+year, so they do not prove the claimed day.
Found compound vote checks may match one X-Y tally while other chamber/stage tallies remain unchecked.
Found sponsors check last names, not full identity/party/district; partial does not establish all sponsors.
Failure-reason checks may match a vote or committee phrase while leaving causal assertions or dates unsupported.

research_effort.best_roi_next_time: Generate one compact per-field evidence table from all current cached resources before browsing; compound fields need component checks and event context, rather than whole-string matching.

shared_notes.N1: Month/day appears in event context; year is supplied by dated source/context. Resolves missing-year/ordinal/abbreviated-date matching.
shared_notes.N2: No full support established in readable current cited cache; requires contextual review, not an assertion that the record is false.
shared_notes.N3: Core tally or unanimity supported; compound stage/date/named-voter qualifications require separate contextual verification.
shared_notes.N4: Named event weekday reconciles to recorded date within six days before dated article URL; explicit relative-date derivation.
shared_notes.N5: Contextual source reading supports the event/date or named official; adjacent-year and exact-string requirements caused the machine miss. Date-only weekday derivations use the dated article, not the cache capture date.
shared_notes.N6: Available cache is generic JavaScript-driven tracker summary, not jurisdiction detail. Field remains unverified, not contradicted.
shared_notes.N7: New primary search result directly corroborates this metadata; add this specific source as a resource if publishing the field.
